title: DEMO HITS LAND LIKE CAREER HITS
why: His answer of 2026-10-12: gameplay must be exactly the same in DEMO and CAREER, and the time to kill stays as it is now. A DEMO hit took half damage (added for newcomers on 2026-10-11), so the same enemy took twice as long to kill you in DEMO. A DEMO hit now takes exactly what the same hit takes in a CAREER raid. The spawn shield after a 2 player DEMO respawn stays, since the respawn is a mode rule he ordered.
now: A hit in DEMO now does the same damage as in CAREER.
